title: The gene-regulatory evolution of the human skeleton
title_zh: 人类骨骼的基因调控进化
abstract: Abstract Skeletal modifications were central to human evolution, enabling adaptations for bipedalism, large cranial vaults and childbirth 1 . Despite their importance, the genetic changes that gave rise to the unique human form remain mostly unknown 2 . Here we systematically map the gene-regulatory changes that shaped human skeletal evolution. Using massively parallel reporter assays (MPRAs) in chondrocytes, we assayed 561,410 human-derived substitutions in promoters and enhancers, identifying 15,077 loci with human-specific regulatory activity. We then generated human–ape hybrid cells and differentiated them into osteochondral progenitors. Integrating the hybrid cells with MPRA measurements produced genome-wide atlases of human-specific changes in cis -regulatory expression, and the sequence variants that drive them. These atlases reveal an extensive rewiring of the extracellular matrix (ECM), including a marked suppression of glycosaminoglycan (GAG) biosynthesis, leading to an approximately three-to-fourfold reduction in joint GAG content in humans compared with non-human apes. We find that this human-specific shift bears signatures of selection, and is likely to be a key contributor to the exceptional susceptibility of humans to degenerative skeletal diseases 3–5 . Together, our results reveal a coordinated evolutionary remodelling of the human skeletal ECM, and establish a comprehensive framework for dissecting the genetic basis of human skeletal biology.
abstract_zh: 摘要 骨骼改造是人类进化的核心，使人类能够适应两足行走、拥有更大的颅腔和分娩。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但导致人类独特体型的遗传变化大多仍不为人知。本文系统性绘制了塑造人类骨骼进化的基因调控变化。我们在软骨细胞中使用大规模平行报告基因实验（MPRA）检测了561,410个来源于人类的启动子和增强子突变，识别出15,077个位点具有人类特异的调控活性。随后，我们构建了人类-猿类混合细胞，并将其分化为骨软骨祖细胞。将混合细胞与MPRA测量结果相结合，生成了全基因组的人类特异性顺式调控表达图谱及其驱动的序列变异。这些图谱揭示了细胞外基质（ECM）的广泛重组，包括糖胺聚糖（GAG）合成的显著抑制，导致人类与非人类猿类相比，关节GAG含量约减少三到四倍。我们发现这一人类特异性转变具有选择性标记，可能是人类对退行性骨骼疾病异常易感性的关键因素。综上所述，我们的结果揭示了人类骨骼ECM的协调进化重塑，并为解析人类骨骼生物学的遗传基础提供了全面框架。
